# Surfaces through liberttyd (--persist): the program's bytes go through
# the daemon (which leaves OSC 7502 alone) to the window, its event back
# the same way; a second window on the session gets the screen from the
# daemon's snapshot — without the surfaces, which are the window's.
type:python3 @DIR@/surface-probe.py @TOOLS@
key:enter
wait:2.0
expect:SUPPORTED 1
expect-surface:demo
surface-press:demo=cancel
wait:1.0
expect:EVENT click cancel
wait:2.5
expect:DONE
attach-copy:DONE
